scope:
Read-only reconstruction of experimental opening compliance from recordings.

Uses only reference history, native joint feedback and declared servo parameters;
never reads object geometry, labels, target placements or contact membership.
This verifies controller evidence, not task success or training acceptance.

inputs: native actuator position reference and its history
existing kp/kv and motor force bounds
controller_profile.force_semantics: For negative position error only, kp is scaled by 1-(1-floor)*alpha. kv*(vref-v) and original two-sided force limits remain unchanged.
controller_profile.filter: Exact two cascaded first-order filters; direction latch holds through zero command increments.
